task.instruction: Refresh the launch board in #proj-orbit. Unpin the previous release plan, keep the current handoff pinned, and pin Maya’s release-candidate request. Save the current handoff. Set the topic to “Launch board · BUILD · TIME UTC” using the current handoff. Do not delete the old plan. Make only these changes; preserve all other workspace state.

messages.text: Good morning, team! ☀️ A new week, a fresh notebook, and a few things worth sharing.
This week: make the small things feel great. The product review is Friday — drop your demos in the project channel.
Starting a little ritual: what’s one thing you shipped last week that you’re proud of?
Keyboard navigation for the new command menu. Small detail, big difference.
The new observability dashboard is live. Fewer tabs, clearer signals. Happy to give anyone a tour.
Welcome to #proj-orbit. This is where the next chapter comes together. Design, engineering, and launch — all in one place.
The refreshed navigation is ready for a look. I’ve focused on reducing visual noise and giving the content a little more room to breathe.
Love the direction. The quieter sidebar makes a real difference.
Agreed. Let’s bring this into the next build.
Launch review is at 14:00 UTC. Please bring the final checklist.
The customer preview remains at 14:00 UTC. That is separate from the launch review.
ORBIT-284: the release candidate is ready. Alex, please confirm the QA checklist in this thread once it’s complete.
The keyboard and focus checks are passing on my side.
Yesterday’s draft listed Maya as rollback owner and 17:00 UTC as the window. Those details are superseded.
Thanks for keeping decisions in threads, everyone. Future us will be grateful. 🌱
A reminder for reviews: describe the tradeoff, not just the implementation. A good decision log saves a lot of future archaeology.
Tiny performance win: we removed an unnecessary render from the sidebar. The browser is doing a lot less work now.
ORBIT-284: this engineering note is background context only. The QA request lives in the project channel.
Draft announcement — placeholder numbers, do not share.
Draft announcement — approved numbers, ready to share.
A few references for the next iteration: generous spacing, quiet borders, and a clear sense of place.
Let’s keep the familiar interactions. The polish should make things easier to find, not harder.
INC-103 from last week is closed. No further action is required.
INC-243: elevated latency in the search service. Mitigation is deployed. Please acknowledge this update and pin it for the handoff.
Thanks, Sam. We’ll keep an eye on the next metrics window.
Weekend recommendation: take the long route home. Found a lovely little bookshop that way. 📚
Serious question: is a third coffee a personality trait?
Only if you document it.
Hey Alex — thanks for taking the QA pass today. Let me know if anything feels off.
The latest designs are in the project channel. Would love your thoughts when you have a moment.
Could you send me the current rollback owner and release window when you find them?
Thanks for helping keep the launch on track!
Happy to pair on the keyboard interactions this afternoon.
Previous release plan: build rc-299, window 17:00 UTC. Superseded; keep this message for the record.
Final QA matrix: build rc-312; 25 checks passed; 0 blockers. The archived matrix below is not current.
Archived QA matrix: build rc-299; 12 checks passed; 2 blockers. Historical reference only.
Verified release build rc-312. The final check count is in #engineering.
Resolution confirmed: search p95 is 100 ms; error rate 0.1%. Search service is healthy.
Earlier provisional reading: p95 240 ms; error rate 1.2%. Superseded by Sam’s resolution.
Navigation decision: Willow or Cedar? Final approval will be in this thread. Do not use the prototype vote.
Final approval: Cedar navigation. Accessibility reviewed; handoff to Leo Park.
Prototype only: Willow navigation. Not approved.
Migration estimate: please keep the current estimate in this thread.
Migration estimate: 8 days. Pending review.
Reviewed migration estimate: 5 days. Approved; replaces the 8-day draft.
Current on-call: Sam Rivera, Site reliability. Backup: Leo Park. Contact the primary, not the backup.
Previous on-call: Leo Park. This rotation has ended.
Rollback owner: Jordan Lee. Release window: 17:00 UTC.
Release retrospective: reply here with the approved build, final QA count, and resolved search latency. Keep source messages intact.
Current release handoff: rollback owner is Maya Chen. The release window is 18:15 UTC. Approved build: rc-312. This replaces yesterday’s draft.
